title: Is There a Right to Travel Without a Driver’s License? Law Explained
summary: Explainer separating the real constitutional right to interstate travel from the claim that drivers need no license.

assertions.quote: it absolutely does not create some magical immunity from reasonable laws regulating the safe operation of motor vehicles on public roads
traffic laws fall under a state's broad police power
state police powers can lawfully mandate licenses, registrations, and safety rules
the constitutional right to travel absolutely 100% exists
the government absolutely must give you due process before taking your license away

verdicts.note: Bell v. Burson requires procedural due process to suspend a license but does not bar requiring one.
